projectDescription: Rikka is a native Android app that lets you chat with multiple AI providers — OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and more — from a single beautiful interface.
keyFeatures: Multi-provider AI support (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and any OpenAI-compatible API)
Material You design with dynamic color and dark mode
Multimodal input — images, PDFs, DOCX files
Built-in web search via Exa, Tavily, Brave, Perplexity, and more
Message branching for exploring alternate conversation paths
AI memory — persistent facts recalled across conversations
Web UI accessible from any browser on your local network
Backup & sync via WebDAV or S3-compatible storage
Custom assistants with system prompts, regex transforms, and lorebooks
QR code sharing for provider configurations
publicApiSurface: Assistant (systemPrompt, temperature, topP, contextMessageSize, mcpServers, enableMemory)
SearchService (Exa, Tavily, Brave, Perplexity, Zhipu, LinkUp, Bing, SearXNG, Grok, Jina, Firecrawl, Ollama, Metaso)
TTSProviderSetting (OpenAI TTS, Gemini TTS, System TTS)
QR code export/import for provider settings
